blurb: Guests can take helicopter scenic tours ranging from five to sixty minutes over Lake George, the High Peaks, and the Green Mountains with premium window seating. Flight training is offered from discovery flights through Private, Commercial, Add-on Rotorcraft, and CFI ratings. Special-occasion buyouts and custom aerial commissions are also available.
extraNote: Liability waiver and assumption of risk required · Harris Airport (83K), 12 miles east of Lake George Village · Year-round flying; tours busiest May through October; foliage flights late September through mid-October
